topics.question: How do you greet a new classmate?
topics.example: Hello. My name is Lin. Nice to meet you. What is your name? Could you spell it, please?
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: Where do you keep your school things?
topics.example: My books are on the desk. My schoolbag is under the chair. I put my things away after I finish my homework.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: How would you welcome a visitor?
topics.example: Welcome to our school. This is our classroom. We read and study here. Let me show you the library next.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: How would you introduce yourself to a new friend?
topics.example: My name is Li Ming, and I live in Henan. I am in Grade Seven. I like tennis and music. What do you enjoy doing?
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: What is a person in your family like?
topics.example: My sister is kind and patient. She helps me with difficult questions. We often take a walk after dinner and talk about our day.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: What is your favourite place at school?
topics.example: My favourite place is the library. It is next to our classroom building. I can read quietly there and borrow interesting books.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: Which subject do you like best, and why?
topics.example: I like science best because I enjoy asking questions. Our teacher helps us do simple experiments. I learn something new in every lesson.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: Which club would you like to join?
topics.example: I would like to join the art club. I enjoy drawing people and animals. I hope to learn new skills and make friends there.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.unit: Unit 6 A Day in the Life
topics.question: What do you usually do on a school day?
topics.example: I get up at seven and have breakfast with my family. After school, I do my homework. I read for twenty minutes before bed.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: How would you plan a birthday celebration?
topics.example: I would invite a few friends to my home. We could make a cake and play games. I would thank my family for their help.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: How can we take care of animals?
topics.example: We should learn what animals need before we keep them. We must give them clean water and enough space. We should also protect wild animals.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: Which school rule is useful, and why?
topics.example: We should arrive at school on time. This helps us get ready for lessons and shows respect for others. I prepare my bag the night before.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: What exercise do you enjoy?
topics.example: I enjoy running because it is easy to start. I run with my friend after school. We warm up first and rest when we feel tired.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: What makes a balanced meal?
topics.example: I usually have rice, vegetables and some fish for lunch. I also eat fruit during the day. I try to choose different kinds of food.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: What are people around you doing now?
topics.example: I am reading in the classroom. My friend is writing a story, and two classmates are discussing a question. Everyone is working quietly.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: How does the weather affect your plans?
topics.example: I usually play outside when it is sunny. If it rains, I read at home or visit the library. I check the weather before making plans.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: Describe a day you remember well.
topics.example: Last month, our class visited a museum in Henan. I saw old tools and learned how people lived. I remember the trip because it made history feel real.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: Can you tell a short story with a clear ending?
topics.example: One day, a boy found a lost dog near his school. He asked an adult for help. They contacted the owner, and the dog returned home safely.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文
